item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
The town fair had a booth where people could trade cards.

[Image: one animal card, an equal sign, and two cartoon cards.]

1 animal card is worth 2 cartoon cards.

[Image: two animal cards, an equal sign, and three sports cards.]

2 animal cards are worth 3 sports cards.

Some children went to the booth to trade cards.

Trading Animal Cards

B. Jim had 8 animal cards to trade for sports cards. How many sports cards would he get?

Answer: ____ sports cards

descriptors: Other incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

item.figure_description:
Two trade equations are illustrated with rectangular cards:
1. Top equation: 1 card depicting a bear is on the left, an equals sign (=) is in the middle, and 2 identical cards depicting an oval cartoon face are on the right.
2. Bottom equation: 2 identical cards depicting a bear are on the left, an equals sign (=) is in the middle, and 3 identical cards depicting a sports player kicking a ball are on the right.
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.
